name: choir_glow
character: A distant choir on open vowels behind the listener, more air than words: it appears where the field itself seems to sing and leaves before it becomes a feature.
description: The aura: mixed choir on oohs, long tones only, entering under the crush and returning through the dilation and the last ascent.
sources: KB cinematic-hybrid-scoring section 2 | a cluster or held chord needs inner movement; the choir moves only when the strings do, so it reads as colour under them
KB soundfont-velocity-and-realism section 4 | soft choral entries are darker; velocity_timbre keeps them behind the strings; starting values
ESTIMATE: azimuth -108 deg, 22 deg up, 4.6 m and -11 dB gain are starting values for a choir heard from the far left of a very large field
